defective_pattern: Emitting orchestrator-to-user dialogue, stage completion reports, or meta-conversational messages in the artifact's target language (Persian) due to context token contamination, violating the English-only conversation rule.
why_defective: Violates the user's communication standard and blurs the boundary between artifact generation and process orchestration.
observed_symptoms: Emitting Persian text in turn conversational responses
Orchestrator reporting status in Persian instead of English
corrective_remedy: Enforce strict contextual language decoupling: 100% of conversational dialogue, progress summaries, reports, and questions with the user must strictly be in English. Persian is restricted exclusively to academic text written inside deliverable artifacts on disk.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Flag any assistant turn dialogue containing Persian script outside deliverable artifact contents.
